module: Flowgraph node "Get Recovery Prompt Button Limit and Count" (category once_instant, recoveryPrompt color/icon, depends on gameplay_walk). Reads core_recoveryPrompt.getButtonLimitsAndCounts() and returns for the chosen button (id pin) its limit (limit) and its usage counter (count). Values -1 if absent from the button data, nil if the id is unknown. In the editor, the id pin offers the values flipMission, recoverMission, submitMission and restartMission.

postInit.desc: Sets the predefined values (hardTemplates) of the id pin.

workOnce.desc: Reads the limits/counters and fills limit and count for the given id.
